description: This file implements a SPDY protocol executor for remote command streaming in Kubernetes, handling connection setup, protocol negotiation, and stream management.

classes.name: spdyStreamExecutor
classes.description: Handles SPDY connection and stream management for remote command execution.

methods.name: NewSPDYExecutor
methods.description: Creates a new SPDY executor with default transports based on config.

methods.name: NewSPDYExecutorRejectRedirects
methods.description: Creates a SPDY executor that rejects redirects during connection upgrade.

methods.name: NewSPDYExecutorForTransports
methods.description: Creates a SPDY executor with specified transports.

methods.name: NewSPDYExecutorForProtocols
methods.description: Creates a SPDY executor with specified protocols for testing.

methods.name: newConnectionAndStream
methods.description: Establishes a new SPDY connection and protocol stream handler.

methods.name: StreamWithContext
methods.description: Streams with context cancellation and error handling.
